prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. EDIT Image 1, the music-room interior, to match the hand-drawn PENCIL AND WATERCOLOR medium of Image 2, the goblin music lesson style reference. Preserve Image 1's beautiful monastery room composition, piano left, arched mountain window center, music stand, stools, cello and lute right, old stone and wood, and inviting sunlit mood. The finished output must read as a loose artist's concept illustration, NOT a photograph or polished realistic render. Redraw all architecture and props with clearly visible expressive violet/graphite pencil lines, imperfect searching contours and light cross-hatching. Substantially simplify ornamentation, rug pattern, stone texture and instrument detail. Broad transparent muted watercolor pools, pale warm ivory paper showing through much of the image, lost-and-found edges, airy faded peripheral architecture. Match Image 2's color economy and loose sketch quality, with foreground contours a little stronger than the background. Soft ochre, dusty sage, pale lavender and blue washes; preserve beautiful light through paper-white areas, not photographic GI. No people, no collage, no typography. Standalone wide landscape illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single polished landscape Unity game environment LOOK-DEVELOPMENT CONCEPT SHEET. Use Image 1 as the architecture and composition reference for THE SAME MUSIC ROOM in ALL SIX PANELS. Present EXACTLY SIX rendered 3D game art directions, arranged two rows of three, all equal-sized. These must clearly look like different possible Unity realtime game art treatments, not watercolor paintings. Preserve identical eye-level camera framing, upright piano at left, twin arched mountain window at center, music stand and round stools in middle, cello/lute/frame drum at right, vaulted medieval monastery stonework and wood. Keep geometry placement consistent so a viewer can compare styles. Lighting cues inspired by Meta Quest's in-device immersive home lobby: generous soft directional daylight, bright airy mountain outlook, warm indirect interior fill, gentle contact shadows, subtle warm practical lights, quiet atmospheric depth, controlled highlights, gentle material separation. Emulate that light quality, do not copy its modern architecture or add Meta UI. Six distinct looks: 01 'Soft Geometry' — simplified beveled low-poly shapes, warm matte materials, big clean color regions, honey sun and cool blue fill. 02 'Painted World' — medium-detail shapes with visible hand-painted albedo brushwork and crafted stylized surfaces, sage/ochre/powder-blue, soft daylight. 03 'Tactile Realism' — grounded detailed wood, limestone and cloth PBR surfaces, warm realistic sun bounce, rich but controlled realistic game rendering. 04 'Living Sketch' — simplified 3D with violet fine contour shader and lightly hatched surfaces, pale paper-like textures and restrained wash-colored materials, still visibly volumetric realtime 3D, bright soft daylight. 05 'Sculpted Storybook' — chunky rounded carved shapes, tactile clay-like materials, gentle bevels, muted colors and exceptionally soft lobby-like skylight. 06 'Enchanted Dusk' — restrained stylized PBR, blue-violet mountain twilight, warm brass lamps, amber window-edge light, soft readable shadows, very subtle bloom. Clear narrow ivory gutters, slim neutral title strip. Exact title 'MUSIC ROOM / UNITY LOOK DEVELOPMENT'. Each caption contains only its number and exact short look name. No technical settings, no performance claims, no UI, no people, no watermark. Generous scene-to-text ratio, beautiful art-director presentation sheet, high visual distinction between all six without changing the room.
